name: album-studio-workspace
description: 电子相册工作室跨平台桌面应用

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:web
scripts.check: npm run check:env && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:all && npm run test:dev-smoke && npm run test:e2e:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace album-studio-desktop && eslint --config apps/desktop/eslint.config.mjs apps/web packages/common packages/studio
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @album-studio/common && npm run test --workspace @album-studio/studio && npm run test --workspace album-studio-desktop
scripts.test:e2e:all: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:web
